text: waya (/home/ayush/projects/waya) is a C++26 server-side web framework porting maya's type-state philosophy from terminal to web; Phase 0 spike is green (21/21, ./spike/run_spike.sh, GCC 16). Two hard-won rules: (1) keep NTTP config structs TINY — GCC prints the full NTTP value in every instantiation frame, so char arrays inside ElemCfg inflated diagnostics from 6 to 31 lines; put values in members, flags in the type. (2) For readable errors, do NOT gate a factory with `requires` (gives a 37-line overload-resolution dump) and do NOT static_assert on a concept (GCC appends the satisfaction derivation) — instead accept any child and assert on a plain `bool` inside a helper TYPE, triggered by instantiation not a constexpr call; plus ship -ftemplate-backtrace-limit=1.
